column1: 2.3.2.3 Transmitter Unit (HB). This sub-system employs a Servo based transmitter
with 10KW ERP to handle conventional and exotic Radars. The transmitter amplifies the
modulated jammer RF signal using TWT, and radiates through narrow beam jammer
antenna having a beam width of 7 X 7 @ 37 GHz, to achieve the required ERP. Two
transmitters will be positioned, one each on Port & Starboard side of the Foremast and
each transmitter covering 180 sector, capable of handling one threat per sector. These
transmitters are positioned on two axis servo pedestal to position the narrow jammer beam
on the threat radar based on DOA information and to compensate the roll, pitch and yaw
